The Indian Men’s Hockey Team put up a determined fight against the Netherlands in their Round 2 clash of the FIH Hockey World Cup Belgium & Netherlands 2026, going down 1–3 in a hard-fought encounter.
Captain Harmanpreet Singh converted a penalty corner to score India’s only goal of the match, but the Netherlands found the net three times to secure the win.
Watch the highlights from an intense India vs Netherlands clash as the Indian Men’s Team battled until the final whistle at the Wagener Stadium.
